== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Known as ''The Third Prince of [[EDward Gaming|EDG]]''.
* Known for his confident words after winning games.
* One of two players to play on all three LPL world champion teams ([[EDward Gaming|EDG]], [[Invictus Gaming|IG]], and [[FunPlus Phoenix|FPX]]).
=== Statistics ===
* Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on July 05, 2024.
** Was the 32nd player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL.
* Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on July 16, 2024.
** The 49th player to reach 1000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 500 games in the LPL on June 4, 2025.
** The 34th player to reach 500 games in the LPL.
* Reached 300 wins in the LPL on August 30, 2025.
** Was the 25th player to reach 300 wins in the LPL.
